name: Portkey AI Gateway
short_desc: Open-source AI gateway for routing to 250+ LLMs with observability, caching, and rate limiting
author: Portkey AI
description: Portkey AI Gateway is a lightweight, open-source proxy that routes requests to 250+ LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and more) through a single OpenAI-compatible API. It adds production-grade features on top of any provider: request routing and failover, caching, rate limiting, retries, load balancing, and full observability with logs and analytics.
